orientation.top_of_map: west wall of the long hall; the hall's north end runs off the left edge, the shore steps at the south end on the right
orientation.scale_note: plan in true hall units. Swim beats are shot at x12 on the tank build (Alice effective height about 11 cm); positions scale with the build, xy stays the same.
orientation.flood_extent: water covers the hall floor from the north end to the shore steps at the south end; the glass table stands in the water. See DEF-p4-envconcept-601 for the open conflict with 'north half flooded'.
orientation.note_en: camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks; xy_m = xy x map_extent_m (origin top-left). Own frame, not the SCN-long-hall frame: as drawn the water band spans y 0.31-0.69 and the hall runs off the left edge. Floating props are drift start positions. The low curtain is not drawn in this image and is not registered as a landmark here.

views.desc_en: water-level wide shot from among the glass table legs down the flooded hall to the broken stone steps climbing out of the water into reeds and grass
water-level medium shot from beside the floating fan toward the clear glass table legs rising out of the water like columns, gold lamp reflections trembling around them
high oblique wide shot from above the shore steps back over the whole sheet of water to the flooded corner entrance, the swimmers' wakes spreading in rings
water-level close shot from the flooded entrance gap to the floating white kid gloves, the wet door bases and whiplash iron frames rising like cliffs beyond
eye-level medium shot at swimmer height from the glass table legs back toward the floating fan drifting on the still water
eye-level medium shot at swimmer height straight across the flooded hall to the door bases of the west wall, mosaic reflections rippling between
eye-level close shot through the reeds to the first broken stone step, grass growing through its joints, water lapping at its edge
eye-level wide shot at swimmer height from the flooded corner entrance diagonally across the water to the door bases of the west wall, lamp reflections trailing away down the hall
high oblique detail shot down from the drifting fan onto the white kid gloves floating on the clear salt water, gold lamp reflections around them

calibration.method: landmark xy re-measured on the delivered layout_top.png (door/opening landmarks read at the gap in the wall line)
